product.title: Golden Gate Bridge Bike Tour with Muir Woods and Sausalito Tour

description.text: Start in Fisherman’s Wharf with bike fitting and route orientation, then ride a guided bayfront route toward the Golden Gate Bridge before descending into Sausalito. After time on the Marin waterfront, the experience shifts to a small-coach segment for Muir Woods National Monument, where the schedule allows independent walking among old-growth coastal redwoods. The day finishes with a return toward San Francisco, with ferry-upgrade logistics handled according to the booked option. This is a full-day combination tour for travelers who want cycling, Sausalito, and redwood forest time in one structured outing.

highlights: Ride from Fisherman’s Wharf across San Francisco’s northern waterfront toward the Golden Gate Bridge.
Cross the Golden Gate Bridge by bike with guide-managed pacing and photo opportunities.
Use free time in Sausalito before continuing by minicoach.
Walk independently in Muir Woods National Monument with entrance included in the tour format.

start.description: 2715 Hyde Street, San Francisco, CA 94109. Arrive before the 10:00 AM departure for bike fitting, equipment assignment, and orientation.

end.description: 251 Mason Street, San Francisco, CA 94102. The return is by minicoach unless a ferry-return option is selected according to booking details.

itineraryItems.title: Fisherman’s Wharf bike orientation
itineraryItems.description: Meet at the Hyde Street bike location for check-in, equipment fitting, and a safety briefing before the guided ride begins.

itineraryItems.title: Bayfront ride toward the bridge
itineraryItems.description: Bike through San Francisco’s northern waterfront toward the Golden Gate Bridge while the guide manages pace and road crossings.

itineraryItems.title: Golden Gate Bridge crossing
itineraryItems.description: Ride the bridge path with time for bay, city, and headlands views from the span.

itineraryItems.title: Sausalito bike handoff and lunch time
itineraryItems.description: Descend into Sausalito, return the bike to the designated handoff point, and use free time for lunch or a short waterfront walk.

itineraryItems.title: Sausalito minicoach meeting point
itineraryItems.description: Regroup at the scheduled Sausalito pickup location for the afternoon coach segment toward the redwoods.

itineraryItems.title: Muir Woods National Monument
itineraryItems.description: Walk through Muir Woods National Monument among coastal redwoods on established paths and boardwalks at your own pace.

itineraryItems.title: Sausalito return window
itineraryItems.description: Return through Sausalito for a final short break or ferry-option handoff before the coach continues toward San Francisco.

itineraryItems.title: San Francisco drop-off
itineraryItems.description: Return to San Francisco for the Union Square-area drop-off after the combined bike, Sausalito, and Muir Woods itinerary wraps up.

inclusions: Choice of electric bike or deluxe traditional bike according to selected option
Helmet, lock, handlebar bag, and rear rack
Minicoach transportation for the Sausalito and Muir Woods segment
Muir Woods National Monument entrance fee
additionalInfo: Travelers should have a moderate physical fitness level and be comfortable riding a bicycle outdoors.
The tour is not recommended for travelers with serious back, heart, or mobility concerns.
Service animals are allowed according to operator policy.
Group size is limited by the selected tour operation and vehicle capacity.
You can cancel up to 24 hours in advance for a full refund.

faqs.question: Where does this Golden Gate Bridge and Muir Woods tour start?
faqs.answer: The tour starts at 2715 Hyde Street in Fisherman’s Wharf, where travelers check in for bike fitting and orientation before departure.

faqs.question: Is Muir Woods included on the same day?
faqs.answer: Yes. After the bike ride and Sausalito time, the itinerary continues by minicoach to Muir Woods National Monument.

faqs.question: Can travelers choose an e-bike?
faqs.answer: The product offers an electric-bike or deluxe traditional-bike choice according to the option selected at booking.

faqs.question: How much cycling is involved?
faqs.answer: The bike portion follows an approximately eight-mile route from Fisherman’s Wharf across the Golden Gate Bridge to Sausalito.

faqs.question: Does the tour return to San Francisco?
faqs.answer: Yes. The standard itinerary returns by minicoach to a San Francisco drop-off near Union Square, with ferry-option details handled through the booked option.
